root_idea.summary: The root centers on slipping or moving away from a place, and in its reduplicated development on repeated or violent movement, agitation, and convulsion.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of movement away or smooth passage come figurative error and slipping from the right course; the reduplicated form زلزل extends this into sustained agitation, shaking, and earthquake-like motion.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form زَلْزَلَ.
Displayed as the independent verbal noun زَلْزَلَة.
Displayed as the independent noun زِلْزَال.

senses.definition: To be violently shaken or convulsed; of the earth, to quake.
senses.usage_conditions: Attested in the Quran chiefly in the passive perfect, describing physical shaking or convulsion.

senses.definition: To be thrown into severe agitation, fear, or an unsettled state.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of people or a group undergoing intense trial; the passive construction presents the resulting agitation rather than an agent's action.

senses.definition: A convulsion or violent shaking; an upheaval.
senses.usage_conditions: An event noun denoting the occurrence or state of violent movement.

senses.definition: Violent shaking, commotion, or an earthquake; a severe upheaval.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun for intense physical or figurative agitation, including an earthquake or a grave shaking of circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slip, move aside, or pass away from one's place; figuratively, to err or make a mistake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of slipping in mud and of lapses in speech, action, judgment, opinion, or religion; also used for turning aside from a course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a benefit, to pass or be transferred from one person to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing the transfer of a benefit from a benefactor to its recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass along quickly or run; to move lightly or nimbly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of rapid or agile movement, including movement from place to place in search of pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of life, to pass or glide away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression for the passing away of a person's life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of money, to pour or flow out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of dirhams or similar pieces of money.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of money, to become deficient in weight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of coins or pieces of money whose weight falls short.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become lean in the hips or haunches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical description concerns lack of flesh in the posterior and thighs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive something offered, especially food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use discussed in legal phrasing concerning knowledge of permission or consent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be made or rendered thin or slender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare passive or resultative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to slip, fall, or commit an error.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May concern slipping physically or falling into error in speech, judgment, opinion, or religion; also used in Quranic interpretations of causing persons to slip.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove or cause someone to move away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an alternate interpretation of a Quranic construction otherwise understood as causing someone to slip.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send or advance someone to a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction with a person as the one sent forward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone turn away from an opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used causatively with a person's view or judgment as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give or bestow a benefit, food, or part of someone's due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative transfer construction with a recipient introduced by إِلَى or a specified share of food or entitlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw a benefit forth from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative benefit-transfer construction distinct from bestowing a benefit on someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive camels roughly, violently, or vehemently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use describing forceful driving of animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause liquid to slip into the throat or pass into the fauces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use illustrated with cold water entering the throat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become in a state of motion, agitation, convulsion, or violent movement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or quasi-passive construction, including the earth's quaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the soul, to tremble or move within the chest at death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression for the soul's agitation at the time of death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slippery place or surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a place where the foot slips, including a smooth slope or slide.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slip, lapse, fault, wrong action, mistake, or sin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for an error or fall into wrongdoing, especially a serious or disapproved act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A benefit, good action, gift, or benefaction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nounal use referring to something beneficial bestowed on another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A feast or repast prepared for guests; a marriage feast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In a dialectal use, it can also denote food carried from a friend's or relation's table.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A straitened or difficult state of the breath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal use; the transmitted wording is associated with constricted breathing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stones or smooth stones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is زِلَلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A deficiency, especially a shortfall in weight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for deficiency in a balance or measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small white animal said to cool water when placed in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare traditional zoological designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, cool or cold, sweet, clear, pure, and easy to swallow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description can emphasize sweetness, clarity, coolness, or its quick and smooth passage down the throat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clear or limpid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may be applied to things generally, not only to water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sweet food known as فَالُوذ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized food term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A carpet or a particular kind of woollen floor covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A loanword used for a type of carpet or mat; its plural is زَلَالِيّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Household goods, utensils, or furniture of a house or tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or plural-like noun for domestic equipment and possessions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Light or agile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used as an epithet for a boy or young man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skilful player on the drum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized personal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Light or active in body and spirit; mentally quick, clever, or ingenious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective and substantive description of agility and quick intelligence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Conflict, fighting, and an evil or troubled condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for leaving people in a state of conflict and hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Difficulties, terrors, or causes of fear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural noun for troubling circumstances or things that inspire fear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deficient in weight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a dirham, dinar, or other coin whose weight is short.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quick or swift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general adjective of rapid movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lean in the buttocks, hips, or thighs, with little flesh in the rear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person or animal; the feminine form is used of a woman, and the epithet is also applied to a lean or agile wolf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bow, one from which the arrow slips because of the speed of its release.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a rapidly shooting bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An exclamation uttered on occasions of convulsion, alarm, or distress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An interjection associated with the urgency and fear of a shaking or calamity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slippery place, such as a smooth rock or similar surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used metaphorically of a perilous or slippery path.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who bestows many benefits or gifts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial description of a generous benefactor.
